<ic>To create a Conclave title of Imperial Censor

With the power to submit one free Declaration of Interdiction per Conclave session<br>

Term of office – Declaration of Candidacy<br>

Responsibilities – To ensure the Empire is safe from malign magical items, especially those of unknown or unacceptable provenance.
<br><i>Proposed by Miekarova, Seconded by Volodmartz</i></ic>

===Overview===
* Created an [[Imperial Title]] within the [[Conclave]]
* Passed

===Date===
* Summer 380YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The Imperial title of [[Imperial Censor]]
* The title is appointed by [[Declaration#Declaration_of_Candidacy|Declaration of Candidacy]] in the [[Conclave]]
